title: OperationResultV3
description: Bridge reply under contract 3. idempotency_key is required on every reply. `accepted` means the write is durably journaled and queued — it is NOT a completion. `pending` covers accepted/queued/running on a status query. `succeeded` requires a journaled proof whose `ok` is true; `failed` is terminal and can never be queried back into success; `unknown` (including restart-recovered work) blocks dependents until resolved by evidence.

journal_state.description: Persistent journal state at reply time (informational, but must agree with status: accepted ⇒ accepted; pending ⇒ queued|running; succeeded ⇒ succeeded; failed ⇒ failed; unknown ⇒ unknown).
